caption: The drawing depicts two jug-like vessels outlined in black against a plain, off-white background. The vessel on the left is shown in profile, with a single handle attached at the top, curving outward and upward before looping back to join the neck. Both vessels have broad, rounded bodies that taper to a narrow base and a short, cylindrical neck. The left vessel features some partial blue coloring and text on the shoulder area, with the handle and neck also accented in blue. The vessel on the right is shown from the front and displays a more complete area of blue decorative patterns around the neck and middle of the body; it includes blue ornamental floral motifs above and below the text. The text on the right vessel reads “C. CROLIUS MANHATTAN WELLS NEW-YORK,” with the top and bottom lines arched to fit the curve of the vessel. The drawing uses black outlines, blue shading for decoration, and has some handwritten initials or signature at the bottom left.
title: Jug
